newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -BUNDS NEED TO TACKLE 102.12 TO MOVE UP.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -BUNDS NEED TO TACKLE 102.12 TO MOVE UP.

text.p: September Bund futures traded on LIFFE must overcome resistance at 102.12 before they can push higher, but are likely to remain neutral on Tuesday, technical analysts said.

"The outlook is improving slightly but we do have to get over 101.99 which on intra-day charts keeps being massive resistance, and then above that 102.11, 12," said Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at London Bond Broking.
He said Bunds might tackle these levels early in the session, but failing that were likely to remain neutral and remain within the trading range of the past few days.
At 0720 GMT, September Bunds were at 102.14, up 24 basis points on the day.
Ostwald said if Bunds succeeded in breaking higher he would look for a move towards 102.32.
"Then there is a fairly large band of congestion between 102.63 and 102.68," he said.
To the downside, he said the first real support level came in around 101.58, 101.62, Monday and Friday's lows.
Below that a further prop is offered by the old cyclical high at 101.48, Ostwald said.
Tim Hampton, head of futures sales at the Royal Bank of Scotland in London, said an engulfing pattern on candlestick charts suggested a temporary end to down-side pressure.
"This is reinforced by open interest which continues to highlight the marginal preference for buying on dips over selling strength," he said in a note to clients.
A double bottom at 101.50, 58 now opened the way for a more concerted push through 102.00.
But the contract would need to push above value area resistance at 102.20, 102.35 to change the neutral momentum, Hampton said.
At the short end, December Euromark futures were at 96.52, up 0.01 on the day.
